title: Top-dimensional component reduction for intersection positivity
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a proper $k$-scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a nonempty closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] of dimension $d=\dim Z$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $Z_1,\ldots,Z_r$ be the irreducible components of $Z$ of dimension $d$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], with their reduced induced integral closed-subscheme structures [def-pc-integral-scheme]. For each $j$, let $\xi_j$ be the generic point of $Z_j$ [def-sc-generic-point] and put $m_j=\mathrm{length}_{\mathcal O_{Z,\xi_j}}(\mathcal O_{Z,\xi_j})$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length]. For invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_d$ [def-sc-invertible-module], the intersection number of [def-sc-intersection-number] satisfies $(\mathcal L_1\cdots\mathcal L_d\cdot Z)=\sum_{j=1}^r m_j(\mathcal L_1\cdots\mathcal L_d\cdot Z_j)$. Each $m_j$ is positive. In particular, when all $\mathcal L_i=\mathcal L$ is ample [def-sc-ample], positivity of the numbers $(\mathcal L^d\cdot Z_j)$ implies $(\mathcal L^d\cdot Z)>0.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-numerical-polynomial-leading-term] to the coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F=i_*\mathcal O_Z$ and $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_d$ (so $r=d$): $\operatorname{Supp}(i_*\mathcal O_Z)=Z$ has dimension $d$, its $d$-dimensional irreducible components are the $Z_j$ with generic points $\xi_j$, and $\mathcal F_{\xi_j}=\mathcal O_{Z,\xi_j}$, whose length over $\mathcal O_{X,\xi_j}$ equals its length over the quotient ring $\mathcal O_{Z,\xi_j}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length], i.e. equals $m_j$. Hence $\chi(X,i_*\mathcal O_Z\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_d^{\otimes n_d})-\sum_j m_j\chi(X,i_{j*}\mathcal O_{Z_j}\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_d^{\otimes n_d})$ is a numerical polynomial of total degree $<d$, so its coefficient of the degree-$d$ monomial $n_1\cdots n_d$ is $0$. Each $Z_j$ is a nonempty closed subscheme of $X$ of dimension $d$, so by [def-sc-intersection-number] the coefficients of $n_1\cdots n_d$ in the two $\chi$-polynomials are $(\mathcal L_1\cdots\mathcal L_d\cdot Z)$ and $(\mathcal L_1\cdots\mathcal L_d\cdot Z_j)$; comparing coefficients gives the displayed equality.

By [lem-sc-numerical-polynomial-leading-term] each $m_j$ is a positive integer. Therefore, if every $(\mathcal L^d\cdot Z_j)$ is positive, the finite weighted sum $\sum_j m_j(\mathcal L^d\cdot Z_j)=(\mathcal L^d\cdot Z)$ of step 1 is positive (with $r\ge1$ since $Z$ is nonempty of dimension $d$).

lean.statement: theorem intersectionNumber_topDimensionalReduction (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (Z : Scheme.{u}) [Nonempty Z] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z = ((d : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) (r : ℕ) (components : Fin r ≃ {C : Set Z // C ∈ irreducibleComponents Z ∧ topologicalKrullDim C = ((d : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)}) (Y : Fin r → Scheme.{u}) [∀ j, IsIntegral (Y j)] (c : ∀ j, Y j ⟶ Z) [∀ j, IsClosedImmersion (c j)] (hc : ∀ j, Set.range (c j) = (components j).val) (hY : ∀ j, topologicalKrullDim (Y j) = ((d : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) (ξ : Fin r → Z) (hξ : ∀ j, IsGenericPoint (ξ j) (Set.range (c j))) (L : Fin d → X.Modules) [∀ a : Fin d, (L a).IsInvertible] : ∃ m : Fin r → ℕ, (∀ j, Module.length (Z.presheaf.stalk (ξ j)) (Z.presheaf.stalk (ξ j)) = (m j : ℕ∞) ∧ 0 < m j) ∧ intersectionNumber k X Z i d hd L = ∑ j : Fin r, (m j : ℚ) * intersectionNumber k X (Y j) (c j ≫ i) d (hY j) L ∧ (∀ (A : X.Modules) [A.IsInvertible], IsAmple (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) A → (∀ j, 0 < selfIntersectionNumber k X (Y j) (c j ≫ i) d (hY j) A) → 0 < selfIntersectionNumber k X Z i d hd A)
